description: This file defines CMake functions for configuring and installing header-only libraries and packages, including generating configuration files and package configuration files for CMake and pkg-config. The functions facilitate the setup of target properties, dependency management, versioning, and installation behaviors specific to header-only libraries.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only target, generating CMake configuration files, handling dependencies, and creating target aliases.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates a pkg-config (.pc) file for a header-only library target, including compile options, include directories, and linking information.
